domain: Allocates a new AnimationObject: looks up metadata for id via Func_08185000, scans a fixed 64-entry table at Data_03001e5c for a free slot (draw_kind byte at struct offset 4 == 0), and if one is found populates it from metadata and returns its pointer (0 otherwise).
behavior: metadata = Func_08185000(id); if metadata->width == 0, returns 0 without scanning

scans Data_03001e5c[0..63] (24-byte stride) for the first entry whose draw_kind (offset4) byte is 0 -- this is the SAME field later written with metadata->draw_kind, so a nonzero draw_kind doubles as the slot's occupied marker; there is no separate offset21 field

on a free slot: object->id = id; frames = metadata->frames, falling back to Func_0800b798(id) when that is 0; object->animation = metadata->animation (cached in a local so the later dereference reuses it); object->frames = frames; object->frame_codec = metadata->frame_codec; object->marker = 0xff; object->current = *(u32 *)animation (a dereference of the cached animation pointer, not a constant zero, unlike the template's initialize_objects.c sibling); object->state and object->unknown05 both take a shared zero value sourced from Data_00000000 (matching the pool-literal-zero idiom seen in the 08006408/080063bc serial-runtime family) rather than an immediate; object->draw_kind = metadata->draw_kind (offset4, closing the loop with the scan test)
